title: User Roles: Understanding Admin, Finance, and Auditor Access Levels
summary: This document explains access levels for Admin, Finance, and Auditor roles, including transaction approval limits ($100,000 for Admin, $50,000 for Finance), what each role can/can’t do (Admin: user provisioning/role configuration; Finance: initiate/manage payments and reconcile cash; Auditor: read-only), and intended use for each.
faqs: What transaction approval limit applies to the Admin role ($100,000) versus Finance ($50,000)?
Can the Auditor role initiate or approve transactions or edit users and account settings?
What permissions does the Admin role have for user provisioning and role assignment configuration?
What can Finance users do regarding payments, balances, statements, and reconciliation?
What visibility does the Auditor role have into transactions, statements, and activity logs?
How should I choose between Admin, Finance, and Auditor roles based on required approval authority and operational control?
